notes: New quest tracker (Settings > Quest tracker): the quests you are on, over the game, with each objective's progress (1/3) read from the game itself. Pick which kinds to track (Main, Side, Special, Rumours), how many at once and where it sits; it updates when the game reports progress and closes quests that are handed in or dropped. Behemoth overlay: a broken part now shows BROKEN for the rest of the fight instead of refilling to 100% (from the game's own break state, or its health reaching 0).
